Initializes a buffer of this with a 1/0/dword-zeroing loop, writes two surface constants at this+0xC7C and this+0xC80 (init_literals 18446744072619032576 and 18446744072598899917), stores the HWND a4 into this+0x0, registers via the ppvOut COM interface (entries +16 and +12) with the sub_44ED10 callback and unk_5AD3F0 data, then creates and configures a surface object through its vtable: nulls this+0x4, optionally acquires via unk_5AD490, sets surface descriptions with modes derived from a3, writes this+0x24C = 44, and applies unk_5B0E84. Early-exits with a negated surface Release/restore result when this+0x0 != 1, otherwise runs the v13 {20,16,0,0,1024} setup through vtable +24.
